title: Security assurance grade catalog and bundled evidence pricing pilot
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Define a tiered ‘Security Assurance Grade’ catalog and a related bundled evidence offering that customers can purchase as part of Enterprise onboarding. The catalog will map common customer requests (SIG/CAIQ answers, SOC/ISO evidence pointers, encryption/KMS attestation) to discrete evidence bundles with standardized SLAs. The pilot will test pricing elasticity and time-savings for Sales and Legal when handling RFPs and security questionnaires.

Background: Sales and Solutions teams spend ~6–10 hours per large deal assembling attestation evidence. Existing work (modular attestation efforts) reduced duplication but we still lack a productized bundle with clear pricing and an internal workflow to fulfill requests. This ticket scopes a pilot product plus the pricing experiment to evaluate packaging, sales triggers, and operational cost.

Scope:
- Catalog: 3 graded assurance tiers (Standard, Enhanced, Enterprise) with enumerated artifacts for each (SIG matrix subset, encryption attestations, network diagrams, third-party audit summaries, feature-level consent language).
- Bundles: Pre-packaged evidence sets that Legal/SEs can attach to proposals and that Sales can offer as paid add-on credits during contract negotiations.
- Fulfillment flow: Self-serve order in Console for existing Enterprise customers + internal fulfillment playbook for non-self-serve requests.
- Pricing experiment: Run A/B pricing for bundle credits (flat fee vs. credit-per-evidence) with 6 pilot accounts.

Out of scope: Full automation of questionnaire answers, new audit generation, and external attestation procurement.

Deliverables: PRD, pricing matrix, fulfillment runbook, Console UI mockups, experiment configuration in Growth dashboard, post-pilot lessons and recommended go/no-go decision.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog documented with artifacts listed for each Security Assurance Grade
Pricing table published and approved by Finance
Console flow prototype for ordering bundles available in design and linked PR
Fulfillment playbook drafted and validated with Legal and Solutions squads
Pilot executed with at least 6 enterprise customers and outcomes logged
Primary metrics instrumented in Growth and Console dashboards
success_metrics: Reduce average manual evidence assembly time per deal by 40% for pilot customers
Achieve at least 20% attach rate for offered bundles during pilot conversations
Attainment of positive NPS change (+5) among pilot customers for onboarding security clarity
Validate break-even unit cost for bundle fulfillment within 3 months
rollout_plan:
Phase 1 (Weeks 1-3): PRD + catalog definition + finance pricing model. Phase 2 (Weeks 4-6): Console order prototype (mock) + fulfillment playbook + legal signoffs. Phase 3 (Weeks 7-12): Pilot onboarding with 6 customers (split across industry verticals), instrument metrics, and collect qualitative feedback. Phase 4 (Week 13): Post-pilot review, recommended pricing adjustments, and decision on broader launch or iterate.

Communication: Weekly sync with Sales Ops, Legal, and Growth; mid-pilot demo for execs at week 9.
risks_mitigation: Risk: Bundles oversell and cause unscalable manual work — Mitigation: hard cap on pilot orders and fulfillment SLA that gates new sales
Risk: Pricing is unattractive — Mitigation: run two simultaneous pricing arms and track win/loss signals
Risk: Legal reviews vary by customer causing long-tail fulfillment — Mitigation: include 'exceptions' checklist and triage path to dedicated Solutions engineer
Risk: Confusing product language — Mitigation: validated copy with two pilot customers and iterate on tier naming
